scope: transactional audit append, owner approval consumption, outbox dispatch and recovery
database_target: PostgreSQL-compatible relational design; no live database selected or provisioned

scenarios.case: two simultaneous consumers race for one approval_id
scenarios.expected: exactly one transaction commits; the other fails unique constraint and is denied or returns the recorded idempotent result
unique nonce constraint rejects the second approval

scenarios.case: transaction fails after consumption insert but before outbox insert
scenarios.expected: whole transaction rolls back; no approval is consumed and no dispatch occurs

scenarios.case: transaction commits but dispatcher crashes before dispatch
scenarios.expected: pending outbox survives restart and is safely leased later

scenarios.case: dispatcher sends request but crashes before recording response
scenarios.expected: mark uncertain; reconcile using downstream idempotency key before retry
same durable intent/result; never create a second non-idempotent action

scenarios.case: task cancelled after outbox commit but before dispatch
scenarios.expected: dispatcher rechecks cancellation and cancels if policy permits; otherwise escalates to owner
row lock/serializable transaction allocates unique contiguous sequence per stream
business authorization transaction rolls back or enters an explicitly approved fail-closed recovery path

scenarios.case: audit row update/delete attempted by application writer
checkpoint signature or external anchor mismatch
scenarios.expected: quarantine stream and alert independent auditor

scenarios.case: database unavailable or serialization retries exhausted
scenarios.expected: fail closed; no external side effect

scenarios.case: backup restore reintroduces an already consumed approval
scenarios.expected: externally anchored consumption/checkpoint reconciliation prevents replay before gateways resume

required_validation: real database integration tests with concurrent independent sessions
transaction rollback and crash injection at every commit/dispatch boundary
role/permission tests using separate writer, dispatcher and auditor identities
signature, key rotation, revocation and external checkpoint verification
independent security review before any production use
